basic_info.description: Rare and Exceptional Owner-User Investment Opportunity! This mixed-use property at 5284-5290 Mission presents a compelling investment opportunity with a solid cap rate of 10.63%. The well-maintained 4-unit building comprises 2 residential and 2 commercial units, offering excellent income potential in the vibrant Mission neighborhood. The residential units include a 3-bed/1-bath unit and a 1-bed/1-bath unit, both in good condition and without protected tenants. On the ground level, there's a profitable laundromat (business is included in the sale) and an established barber shop, contributing to the diverse income streams of the property. With separate water and PG&E meters, an upgraded electrical system, and an auto magnetic door lock system in the laundromat, this property is well-equipped for efficiency and security. Roof replaced in 2014. Its prime location near public transportation, local businesses, and easy freeway access further enhances its appeal as a promising investment opportunity.
